topic: Sale of Goods Act, 1930 — A. Basics: Sale, Goods, Price

A price fixed by the court

subject: Commercial Law
topic: Sale of Goods Act, 1930 — B. Conditions, Warranties and Implied Terms

subject: Commercial Law
topic: Sale of Goods Act, 1930 — B. Conditions, Warranties and Implied Terms
